author: Widogeist
body:
This might be a dumb question but do you have the Anguish 2.0 enabled? You mentioned just returning to the game, so just making sure you still don't have the Anguish 1.0 running. I'm pretty sure once you activate Anguish 2.0, you can get all paths up to level 1 for free (world, dungeon, raiding, towers), after which you *should* be able to use a demonworking tool on your staff. 

As previously mentioned, the item you're trying to use demonworking tools on has to be at least masterforged upgrade quality. You don't need to remove adornments from the item you're trying to use a tool on, adornments can stay in the item.

Edit: Also to note, you can only upgrade the anguish level of an item to whatever your highest current anguish level is. So if all your paths are only anguish level 1, you can only upgrade an item to anguish level 1. If one path is level 5 but everything else is only level 1, you can still upgrade an item to anguish level 5.

author: KilKillKill
body: The Demonworking tool increases Anguish by 1, but using it resets an item of level 11 or higher back to level 10. To increase that item's Anguish again, you will have to at least Masterforge it. However, I believe that if you are referring to a passive bonus like crit chance, you also need to use the Anguished Crucible.
